quote_text: We came to Chennai after two failed attempts in Dhaka. The team explained every step in Bengali and English. The cost was less than half of what we paid for the second cycle at home, and the response time on questions was within hours.
The hospital arranged Arabic-speaking coordinators from the day we landed. Halal meals were prepared without us having to ask. My wife felt comfortable, which mattered more than anything.

I needed a complex surgery that wasn't available with the same expertise in Dhaka. The Indian visa came through in four days. Recovery was managed well and they handled my follow-up by video call after I returned home.

My father needed bypass surgery and the wait at home was indefinite. Bengaluru's hospital had a slot within a week of our reports being reviewed. He was discharged on day six and we flew home together two weeks later.
attribution_display: T.M., Addis Ababa — patient's son cardiac bypass, 2024

quote_text: Decided to go to India after seeing the NHS waitlist. Knee replacement done in Chennai. Whole trip including flights and recovery stay still cost less than a third of what I would have paid privately at home.

Liver transplant in India was lifesaving for my brother. The Bengali coordinator at the hospital made the whole process easier. We saved roughly half compared to Singapore which we had also considered.
